step.cmd: Click on the Doc Clauses tab. If you do not see Doc Clauses under the Work tab, click the More button from the menu.
Click on the name of each extraction to view where it is located in your document. From this section, you can click on the More button to re-mark, unmark, and delete fields.
Click the filter icon to expose drop-down menus that can help you to refine your search.
